name: Furano Ski Resort

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate Kitanomine zone base position; the Furano zone base (New Furano Prince Hotel) is nearby
Official Prince Snow Resorts Furano page (read 2026-10-03): "Peak 1,074m · Vertical Descent 839m · Base 235m".

Search summary: 28 courses, about 30 km of slopes, two zones (Kitanomine and Furano); lifts given as '1 ropeway, 1 gondola and 7 lifts' — the ropeway is stored as a cable car and the 7 'lifts' as chairlifts. The same summary also said '11 lifts total', so the total is left unknown. Official page (2026-10-03) confirms "2 zones, Furano and Kitanomine, which have 28 trails in total" and the 101-passenger Furano Ropeway.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Prince hotels sit at both zone bases

character: A two-zone resort (Kitanomine and Furano) above the town of Furano in central Hokkaido, operated by Prince Hotels. Its inland location is associated with dry snow, and the town offers restaurants and lodging close to the lifts.
learning: Courses range from beginner to advanced (search summary). Reference, confirm: ski school and rentals operate at both zones.
